## W21 Stop and fallback exercise

W21   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: every action in the table has been demonstrated with observed evidence and time; the result is Pass or Fail against tolerances agreed before the drill; and every failure has a retest.

Source basis: [GRC Workbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) · [AI Impact Assessment Tool](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-Impact-Assessment-Tool) · [Slow AI Kitchen](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen)

**Scenario and pass conditions**

Choose an outage, material error, unauthorized input/action, model change or absent owner. Agree detection and recovery tolerances before the drill.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

| **Action to demonstrate** | **Responsible person** | **Observed evidence and time** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Detect and identify affected work | ________________ | ________________ |
| Pause or restrict operation | ________________ | ________________ |
| Preserve records and notify owner | ________________ | ________________ |
| Use the manual or alternate process | ________________ | ________________ |
| Reconcile outputs and authorize restart | ________________ | ________________ |

**Failure or limitation exposed**

Include actions that could not be reversed, access that could not be revoked and missed response expectations.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Remediation and retest**

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Result Pass/Fail ________  Checker/date ________  Evidence IDs ________

Demonstrate intervention in the approved test environment. A written kill-switch procedure alone is not evidence that a person can stop the deployed workflow. Reversal cannot undo information already disclosed.
